subject: Genetics
title: The Founder Effect
description: A 60-second lesson on The Founder Effect.

hook.text: In 1814, 15 British settlers founded Tristan da Cunha. Today the island has high rates of asthma. Coincidence? No.

buildup.text: The founder effect: a small group colonizes new territory, carrying only a fraction of the original gene pool.

discovery.text: Rare alleles in founders become common in the new population.

twist.text: The Amish have high rates of Ellis-van Creveld syndrome from a single founding couple in the 1700s.

climax.text: Small founding groups amplify randomness. Genetics isn't just about fitness—it's about who shows up first.

punchline.text: Who arrives first shapes who everyone becomes.

quiz.question: What causes the founder effect?
options: A small group carrying limited genetic diversity
